::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 1.1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 829
:::

My dear Miss Yonge	
on money [?] [I](people/person_939.qmd) enclose a [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) as usual. I am off on a brief holiday to Scotland, my American trip being abandoned for this year. I hope to be home for good & may it be so - by the end of September and quite looking forward to seeing you when you come to London in October. In case you have any point of importance to bring before <u>the press</u>, a note to[G.L. Craik](people/person_379.qmd) Eqr. my partner addressed here will get attention at once

I am inclined to think we should make the [Dove](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd) fly well to Aug. It really is very charming.

very truly yours
A. Macmillan
